sn44.6:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahākoṭṭhiko Bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti Isipatane Migadāye || || 2
sn44.6:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Sāriputto sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Mahā-Koṭṭhiko tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkami āyasmatā Mahā-Koṭṭhikena saddhim sammodi ||
sn44.6:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantam Mahā-Koṭṭhikam etad avoca || ||
sn44.6:1.4: Kiṃ nu kho āvuso Koṭṭhika hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || pe ||
sn44.6:1.5: kim panāvuso Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇa ti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.6:1.6: Etam pi kho āvuso avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.6:1.7: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vadesi || ||
sn44.6:1.8: Ko nu kho āvuso hetu ko paccayo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || || I 4
sn44.6:2.1: Rūpārāmassa kho āvuso rūparatassa rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodham ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti ||
sn44.6:2.2: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti ||
sn44.6:2.3: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti ||
sn44.6:2.4: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || ||
sn44.6:2.5: Vedanārāmassa kho āvuso vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa vedanānirodham ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || pe || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || ||
sn44.6:2.8: Viññāṇārāmassa kho āvuso viññāṇaratassa viññāṇasammuditassa viññāṇanirodham ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || pe ||
sn44.6:2.9: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || || 5
sn44.6:3.1: Na rūpārāmassa kho āvuso na rūparatassa na rūpasammuditassa rūpanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtam Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || pe ||
sn44.6:3.2: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || ||
sn44.6:3.6: Na viññāṇārāmassa kho āvuso na viññāṇaratassa na viññāṇasamuditassa viññāṇanirodhaṃ jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || pe ||
sn44.6:3.7: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || || 6
sn44.6:3.8: Ayaṃ kho āvuso hetu ayam paccayoyena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || || 7
sn44.6:4.1: Siyā panāvuso añño pi pariyāyo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn44.6:4.3: Bhavārāmassa kho āvuso bhavaratassa bhavasammuditassa bhavanirodham ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti pissa hoti || pe ||
sn44.6:4.4: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || || 9
sn44.6:4.5: Na bhavārāmassa kho āvuso na bhavaratassa na bhavasammuditassa bhavanirodham jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || pe ||
sn44.6:4.6: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || 10
sn44.6:4.7: Ayam pi kho āvuso pariyāyo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || || 11
sn44.6:5.1: Siyā panāvuso añño pi pariyāyo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn44.6:5.3: Upādānārāmassa kho āvuso upādānaratassa upādānasammuditassa upādānanirodham ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || pe ||
sn44.6:5.4: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || || 13
sn44.6:5.5: Na upādānārāmassa kho āvuso na upādānaratassa na upādānasammuditassa upādānanirodham jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || pe ||
sn44.6:5.6: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || || 14
sn44.6:5.7: Ayam pi kho āvuso pariyāyo || yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || || 15
sn44.6:6.1: Siyā panāvuso añño pariyāyo yena tam vyākatam Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn44.6:6.3: Taṇhārāmassa kho āvuso taṇhāratassa taṇhāsammuditassa taṇhānirodham ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || pe ||
sn44.6:6.4: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa hoti || || 17
sn44.6:6.5: Na taṇhāramassa kho āvuso na taṇhāratassa na taṇhāsammuditassa taṇhānirodham jānato passato yathābhūtaṃ Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || pe ||
sn44.6:6.6: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pissa na hoti || || 18
sn44.6:6.7: Ayam pi kho āvuso pariyāyo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || || V 19
sn44.6:7.1: Siyā panāvuso añño pi pariyāyo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn44.6:7.2: Ettha dāni āvuso Sāriputta ito uttariṃ kim icchasi ||
sn44.6:7.3: taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttassa āvuso Sāriputta bhikkhuno vaḍḍhaṃ natthi paññāpanāyā
